name: verification
description: Verification harness (W038, the W022 falsifiable-verification pattern): evaluation claims are DECLARED before they are checked — a typed claim registry (the W036 policy's integrity requirements — search-history, evidence-chain, deterministic-replay — plus the §13 holdout-coverage axes and the sole-P&L law) with declaration source and evidence needles; adversarial fixtures in, typed verdicts out ({ claim, verdict: PASS | FAIL | PARTIAL, evidence }). A FAIL is a valid outcome (the harness working, not failing); a PARTIAL means the claim held within its declared scope with the limitation disclosed. Checks: evidence-chain integrity (every capsule validates, citations resolve), deterministic-replay integrity (A9 metadata present + twin re-evaluation equality), search-history integrity (declared, carried), holdout-split coverage (the manifest's splits vs the policy's axes — undeclared axes surface as their own finding kind), the sole-P&L law carried forward. Findings are deterministic, ordered, evidence-linked; the assembled harness runs all checks over one experiment evaluation into the content-addressed findings report.
